referents.why: 'who' (hoitines), masculine plural relative, agrees with 'rebels' (stasiastai) in the noun phrase it modifies.

links.why: Self-link: the clause cannot be joined to itself.
The phrase 'called Barabbas' is nested in the noun phrase naming the man.
The relative clause 'who had committed murder' is nested in the noun phrase 'the rebels' inside cl0's prepositional phrase.
